caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with an elaborately decorated backrest and a woven seat. The chair's structure features dark-colored wood, possibly black or dark brown, with green and gold embellishments on the top, sides, and crossbars. The backrest has three horizontal slats, each slightly arched, with the topmost slat being the highest and most curved; all three slats display floral or leaf motifs in green and gold. The vertical posts are topped with green and gold finials. The legs and stretchers of the chair also have green and gold details in the form of lines and small floral patterns. The seat is crafted from light brown or golden-yellow woven material, which stands out against the darker tones of the wooden frame. The drawing is set against a plain, cream-colored background with a faint border outlining the image area and some small, irregular brown stains present to the left of the chair.
title: Ladderback Chair
